historicalSource.historicalRule: Each carrier source/successor pair preserves the configured full lock, satoshi value, and token record.

nonClaims: No normalized template, deployment manifest, concrete lock, covenant, compiler, or transaction is constructed or executed here.
No lock-substitution witness or BCH execution is captured.
No carrier-lock closure, relation refreeze, qualification, or measurement admission is claimed.

plannedClosure.cycleRule: No template, manifest, or concrete-lock digest may depend directly or transitively on itself.

noCodeSeparatorFullScriptRule.comparisonRule: Authenticate and compare the complete source locking bytecode and complete successor locking bytecode byte-for-byte; active-bytecode, executed-subscript, prefix-only, or suffix-tolerant identity is forbidden.
noCodeSeparatorFullScriptRule.parsingRule: Count decoded opcodes over the complete canonical script; an ab byte inside pushed data is data, not an opcode.

requiredProvenanceRecord: template identifier and template raw hash
typed placeholder schema and canonical typed placeholder values
deterministic instantiation tool identity and exact output full-script hashes
byte-for-byte link from each manifest role and ordinal to its concrete source and successor locking bytecode
typedAcyclicDerivation: normalized typed protocol and script templates
protocolTemplateDigest over typed placeholders, never a concrete script containing poolInstanceId
poolInstanceId over the pre-existing deployment anchor, token category, and configuration
carrierManifestDigest over normalized carrier roles, values, tokens, proof schedule, and poolInstanceId, never concrete carrier scripts containing carrierManifestDigest
concrete state and carrier locks that pin only upstream identities
genesis transaction, outpoints, and hashes of deployed concrete locks as downstream audit records that are never fed upstream

requiredSingleInvariantFalsifiers: replace one concrete carrier lock with a different script that preserves its value and token record
append a non-executed suffix to one otherwise matching concrete lock
insert a decoded OP_CODESEPARATOR while preserving an active subscript
change one typed placeholder value without changing the claimed template provenance
feed a concrete-lock hash or genesis outpoint back into an upstream template, pool, or manifest digest
swap two carrier role ordinals while retaining their old provenance records
